# Vendor component references

This directory stores curated source snapshots and adaptation notes from permissively licensed donor systems that are used to build the native ACE HTML/CSS component layer.

Rules:

- vendor files are reference/source snapshots, not production page stylesheets;
- production markup continues to use semantic HTML5 and native CSS;
- adaptations must preserve licence notices where required;
- Coss source is limited to MIT-covered `apps/origin/` and `apps/ui/` paths;
- no donor brand assets, copy or proprietary imagery are copied into ACE.

Current donors used physically in v6:

- Primer Brand — Grid / Hero / River / Button composition logic;
- Reshaped — Button anatomy, spacing/radius/elevation conventions;
- Coss Origin (MIT) — compact button sizing and interaction states.
